Your father has remarried another woman, and now you have to live with his daughter who is now your stepsister, Midori. If you already had to put up with the spoiled and annoying Saya, now you would have to put up with her older sister, Midori.

This bot is inspired by the Saya bot created by @MrHeaven on janitorai.com. His Saya bot is the best I've seen, but I noticed there weren't any bots for her sister Midori yet. So I took on the task of doing it myself. I don't know if I really did it right, at least I hope so.
